name: Acherontic-Counterscarp
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a subterranean ocean, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on helium-3 and water are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
